prompt: In a pencil sketch with light color wash, a train dining car features five distinct figures. On the left sits a woman in a blue hat, her posture upright as she holds a silver spoon. In the center stands a waiter in a white apron, leaning slightly forward while handing a glass of water to the woman. To the right, a man in a gray suit sits slumped in his chair, looking at a folded newspaper on the table. Next to him rests a small brown dog, its head tilted up attentively. Beside the dog lies a leather suitcase, positioned closed and secure. The waiter’s arm extends toward the woman, creating a clear line of interaction between them. The man’s gaze remains fixed on the paper, ignoring the surroundings. The dog sits calmly next to the suitcase, not interacting with it but sharing the space. There is no window visible in the background, keeping the focus entirely on the interior dynamics and the specific arrangement of these five entities within the confined carriage space.
